create_agent_nn_module: create a PyTorch Agent module with actor and critic networks for mean field PPO
build_policy_open_spiel: build an OpenSpiel Policy wrapper around a PyTorch Agent to compute action probabilities
run_rollout_episodes: run rollout episodes to collect trajectory data including states, actions, rewards, and log probabilities
